title: The list multiplicative 1-2-3 bound
statement: Let $G$ be a nice graph, and let $\operatorname{ch}_\Pi^*(G)$ denote the list parameter for the multiplicative labelling problem defined in the paper. **The list multiplicative 1-2-3 bound.** If $G$ is a nice graph, then $\operatorname{ch}_\Pi^*(G) \leq 3$. This is presented as a legitimate guess motivated by the List 1-2-3 Conjecture, rather than as an established conjecture; the supplied text gives no evidence that the bound is true or false.
source_name: Julien Bensmail, Hervé Hocquard, Dimitri Lajou and Éric Sopena, “On a List Variant of the Multiplicative 1-2-3 Conjecture”, arXiv:2102.08052 (2021).
